COMMERCE / INDEPENDENT PROJECT

RIVAQ · رِواق

An Arabic storefront with its own sense of place.

Engineering showcasePrivate source

An Arabic-first responsive storefront with a distinct olive-and-ivory identity, eight departments, connected product discovery, wishlist, cart, and order-review interfaces.

Public project presentation (opens in a new tab)
My contributionProduct flowsEngineeringLinks & evidence
01 / CONTRIBUTION

Frontend design & web implementation

Created the independent RTL storefront experience, connected browsing and basket behaviours, reusable React interface, documented commerce rules, and a separate design-led portfolio case study.

  • Built the responsive storefront around eight departments and a 32-product catalog.
  • Connected URL-shareable filtering, search, product options, wishlist and persistent cart.
  • Built a checkout interface with coupon and shipping calculations, and order-review screens.
  • Created an original architectural identity, Arabic-first styling and a standalone public visual case study.
Scope & status

Project scope focuses on front-end design and React implementation: product discovery, product details, wishlist, cart, and checkout interface.

Inside the experience

02 / PRODUCT FLOWS
01

Discover

Browse eight categories, featured items, product photography, offers and a shared search interface.

02

Choose

Filter, sort, inspect product variants and save items to a local wishlist and cart.

03

Review an order

Review EGP totals, apply coupon rules, and browse the checkout and order-confirmation views.

03 / ENGINEERING

Behind the interface.

Typed component boundaries

React 19 and TypeScript with catalog data, commerce calculations, app state and route components separated.

RTL design system

CSS design tokens, logical directions, accessible controls, reduced-motion handling and responsive product grids.

Browser quality checks

Playwright checks exercise shopping flows, coupon and free-shipping calculations, and four responsive viewport widths.
